title: eludite.forge.check_log input
description: A check's log (a job's or a run's), as text, paged by bytes: `offset` (default 0) and `max_bytes` (default 262144, at most 2 MB); the Checks log document shows the first 2 MB and links the rest. Read. The repository is the workspace's (its remote `origin`, or `remote`), detected as eludite.forge.detect does; every call runs on the forge worker off the UI thread with a timeout and stops when canceled. A call that needs a token when none is stored for the host fails with `sign_in_required: <host>`: the person signs in (Git > Sign in to <forge>); an agent cannot.

remote.description: The git remote to read (default `origin`, else the only remote).
